FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Precision Engineering & Surveyors specializes in providing high-quality civil engineering and surveying services. Our operations encompass a range of projects, including land surveying, site analysis, and infrastructure planning. We utilize advanced, certified surveying equipment to ensure the accuracy and reliability of our data. Our team of licensed professionals is committed to maintaining rigorous safety protocols and adhering to all regulatory requirements, which includes avoiding any operations that involve hazardous materials or high-risk activities. We prioritize thorough risk management and conduct regular employee safety training to mitigate operational hazards. With a focus on delivering exceptional service, we aim to support residential and commercial development projects while ensuring compliance with all necessary permits and licensing.

Our firm specializes in geophysical exploration, utilizing methods such as explosives and seismic testing to analyze subsurface conditions for a variety of projects.
